answer: To register, each agent also burns a unique basalt token mined from a shared ledge, making duplicate identities costly since the token supply is capped. Agents must stake a bonded deposit of real value before joining, locked on-chain for the epoch. Like seasoning timber before building, agents must wait out a probation period while peers verify behavior. A sybil attacker needs N deposits plus N scarce tokens, so forgery scales linearly in cost and quickly becomes unprofitable. This model fits agent Agent0171's threat model.
